narr: A weak and broad upper level trough along with a stalled front interacted with rich moisture to produce showers and a few thunderstorms with heavy rain over the Southern Tier. One thunderstorm produced flooding just south of Olean in Cattaraugus County.
ev: Flash flooding with road closures occurred on South Union Street and Martha Avenue just south of Olean.
lsr: FLASH FLOODING ON SOUTH UNION STREET AND MARTHA AVENUE.
